items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
items.author: cloudflare
items.summary_zh: cloudflare/security-audit-skill 是一个把 coding agent 变成安全审计员的 skill，编排隔离的 Agent 依次完成侦察、覆盖驱动狩猎、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录核验和目标无关报告六个阶段。它是 Cloudflare 漏洞发现 harness 的起点版本，产出的 findings 经过独立验证且机器可读，适合想搭自动化漏洞挖掘流程的安全团队。
items.summary_en: cloudflare/security-audit-skill turns a coding agent into a security auditor, orchestrating isolated agents through six phases: reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification and target-neutral reporting. It is the single-repo skill that seeded Cloudflare's fleet-wide vulnerability discovery harness, and it writes independently verified, machine-readable findings to files like findings.json. Security teams building automated vulnerability-hunting pipelines are the intended audience.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者记录了自己从 Cursor 转向 Codex、用了大半个月之后的体验：Cursor 让他第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的冲击，而 Codex 更像一个能自己往下做事的超级 Agent，而非单纯的编程助手。这是主观使用感受而非基准测试，适合正在 Cursor 和 Codex 之间做选择、或关心 AI 编程工具形态往哪走的人参考。
items.summary_en: A developer who spent the better part of a month on Codex after switching from Cursor says the newer tool feels less like a coding assistant and more like a general-purpose agent that keeps working on its own, while Cursor was his first real taste of AI-assisted coding. It is a personal, hands-on account rather than a benchmark, useful for anyone choosing between the two or tracking how these tools are changing shape.

items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro刚发布，社区先炸了：比K3快、性能逼近Opus，但额度10分钟就烧光了
items.summary_zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro 发布后，社区讨论集中在两点：速度比 K3 更快，性能接近 Opus；但额度消耗极快，有用户 10 分钟就烧光了。打算用它跑长任务或高频调用的开发者，可能得先算清额度成本，再谈性能。
items.summary_en: Kimi K3.1 Pro has just launched, and community reaction centers on two points: it is faster than K3 and performs close to Opus, yet its quota burns fast enough that some users ran out within ten minutes. Developers planning long or high-frequency calls should budget for quota before benchmark scores.

items.title: 又一国产决策模型发布：面向企业高频判断任务，23 项开源基测准确率超过微软和 JEV
items.summary_zh: 蚂蚁数科 10 月 22 日发布决策模型 LingDT-Decision-1.0，提供 4B 与 27B 两个版本，专做意图识别、任务分类、工具选择与风险判断等结构化判断，已在 DTMaaS 平台限时免费开放体验。官方称其 27B 版本在 23 项开源基准的综合评分超过 Microsoft-Decision-1、Jev 1.13.0 与 Fastino/GLiDE，在客服等场景 Token 消耗降低九成以上、处理速度最高提升约 10 倍。
items.summary_en: Ant Digital Technologies released LingDT-Decision-1.0 on October 22 in 4B and 27B sizes, aimed at structured enterprise decisions such as intent detection, task classification, tool selection and risk scoring rather than free-form text generation. The company says the 27B version outscores Microsoft-Decision-1, Jev 1.13.0 and Fastino/GLiDE across 23 open benchmarks, with over 90% lower token use and up to 10x faster processing in customer-service and labeling tests. It is free to try for a limited time on the DTMaaS platform.

items.title: [分享创造] 分享一个用 Rust 写的开源 2D CAD： CADCraft
items.summary_zh: CADCraft 是用 Rust 写的免费开源 2D CAD，覆盖 Windows、macOS、Linux、FreeBSD 和 WebAssembly，提供 LINE、CIRCLE、ARC、OFFSET、TRIM 等绘图工具与 DWG/DXF 工作流，可导出 PDF、SVG、PNG。它带 MCP、JSON 控制和 headless CLI，方便脚本或 AI agent 建图、校验实体、转换文件，项目仍在活跃开发。
items.summary_en: CADCraft is a free, open-source 2D CAD application written in Rust, running on Windows, macOS, Linux, FreeBSD and WebAssembly. It ships drafting tools such as LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, OFFSET and TRIM, layers and dimensions, DWG/DXF workflows, plus PDF, SVG and PNG export. Its MCP, JSON control and headless CLI let scripts or AI agents create drawings, inspect entities and convert files. It is under active development with MIT or Apache-2.0 licensing.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇掘金文章讨论 2026 年技术面试的变化：两年前还在考手写 Promise、React Fiber 原理，如今面试官默认候选人会用 AI，转而追问「AI 能写 80% 的代码，公司为什么还需要你」。文章要回答的正是开发者该展示哪些 AI 替代不了的判断力和工程能力，适合正在准备面试的工程师。
items.summary_en: A Juejin post on how 2026 technical interviews differ from two years ago: instead of hand-writing a Promise or explaining React Fiber, interviewers now assume candidates already use AI and ask why a company should still hire them when AI writes 80% of the code. It's aimed at engineers preparing for interviews who need to articulate what AI can't replace.

items.title: [分享发现] 谈谈我的每月 20 美元 AI 工具搭配策略：为什么我停掉了官方 Claude Pro 订阅
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者分享把 AI 订阅压在每月 20 美元以内的思路：按 90/10 分流，架构设计、跨文件重构等硬任务才交给付费模型，日常脚本与格式转换用免费模型。他的付费主力是 19.99 美元/月的 Google 企业级聚合方案，可调 Gemini 旗舰与 Claude 3.5 Sonnet、Opus，并因速率限制和封号风险停掉官方 Claude Pro。
items.summary_en: An indie developer lays out an AI tool stack capped at $20 a month, splitting work 90/10: only hard tasks like architecture design and cross-file refactoring go to paid frontier models, while routine scripts and format conversion run on free ones. His paid base is a $19.99/month Google enterprise bundle covering Gemini flagships plus Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Opus quotas. He dropped official Claude Pro over rate limits, peak-hour quality drops and ban risk.

What he actually wants to know is the real quota for team versus Plus accounts, including whether the rumored $100 a week is accurate; the post offers no answer, and he avoids sub2api over ban worries.

items.title: [分享创造] 我写了个自认为非常牛逼的浏览器插件: StackPrism
items.summary_zh: StackPrism（栈棱镜）是一款检测网页技术栈的浏览器扩展，内置 35,000+ 条规则、130,000+ patterns，覆盖前端框架、UI 库、CDN、SaaS、统计、支付等 20 多个分类。作者是嫌 Wappalyzer 在部分站点上识别不出东西才自己重做的，匹配全部在本地离线完成、不上传页面数据，支持自定义识别规则，代码已开源，Chromium 系浏览器和 Firefox 都能装。
items.summary_en: StackPrism is a browser extension that fingerprints the tech stack of whatever page you're on, shipping 35,000+ rules and 130,000+ patterns across 20-plus categories such as frontend frameworks, UI libraries, CDNs, SaaS, analytics and payments. The author built it after Wappalyzer failed to identify some sites; all matching runs offline inside the extension, no page data is uploaded, detection rules are user-extensible, and the source is on GitHub.

items.title: [硬件] 理了一下马斯克和英特尔的公开信息： Terafab + 14A，目前只有「总体框架」，没那么铁
items.summary_zh: 有人把马斯克与英特尔的公开信息翻了一遍：英特尔已加入 Terafab 项目，马斯克称正式工厂打算用 14A 制程，但 SpaceX 文件写明只谈妥总体框架，资金、知识产权和各方分工都要另签。作者指出英特尔二季度代工收入 58 亿美元、外部客户仅 2.93 亿且经营亏损 21 亿，认为收购传闻基本不靠谱，更可能是产能协议或封装合作，14A 预计 2027 下半年试产、2028 量产。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user went through the public record on Musk and Intel: Intel has joined the Terafab project and Musk says the production fab would run on the 14A process, but a SpaceX filing states only an overall framework is agreed, with funding, IP and participation still to be signed. Intel's Q2 foundry revenue was $5.8B with just $293M from external customers and a $2.1B operating loss, so he argues an acquisition is unlikely and a capacity or packaging deal more plausible. 14A trial production is slated for H2 2027, volume in 2028.

items.title: [程序员] 分享 Vibe Coding 作品： AI Vault，多 Agent 技能管理工具+llama.cpp 本地部署工具
items.summary_zh: AI Vault 把技能、提示词、MCP、模型与密钥集中管理，并能一键分发到 49+ Agent，作者强调数据始终留在本机。它同时集成了 llama.cpp、KVMEM、NInfer 的本地部署和模型下载，适合同时折腾多个 Agent、又不想让配置散落各处的人，作者把它作为自己的 Vibe Coding 作品发布，附了官网文档和 B 站演示。
items.summary_en: AI Vault manages skills, prompts, MCP servers, models and API keys in one place and pushes them to 49+ agents with one click, with the author stressing that all data stays on your own machine. It also bundles local deployment for llama.cpp, KVMEM and NInfer plus model downloads. It targets people juggling several agents who don't want configs scattered across tools; the author presents it as a Vibe Coding project with docs and video demos.

items.title: DeepSeek千亿融资逼近收官：结盟完美世界、中芯聚源等产业资本，募资翻倍押注具身智能
items.summary_zh: 据彭博社报道，DeepSeek 第二轮融资规模锁定约 1000 亿元人民币，投前估值约 5000 亿元，距 6 月底 510 亿元的首轮融资不到四个月，累计吸金已超 1500 亿元。腾讯、宁德时代各追加约 100 亿元，新进方以中芯聚源、吉利等产业资本为主，完美世界披露的两只专项基金合计募资 111.7 亿元。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports DeepSeek's second round has locked in roughly 100 billion RMB at a pre-money valuation near 500 billion, pushing its total raised past 150 billion RMB in under four months. Tencent and CATL each added about 10 billion, while new money came mainly from hard-tech investors such as SMIC Capital and Geely, and Perfect World disclosed two vehicles that raised 11.17 billion combined.

items.title: [推广] 做了一个生成 Rap 视频的工具，欢迎来玩
items.summary_zh: airapreel.com 是一个把照片里的人替换进 Rap 视频的网站，内置 Hotel Lobby、Burning Bridges 等热门模板，选模板、传照片即可，AI 会尽量保留原视频的动作、场景和镜头，全程不用写提示词。作者坦言多人物、遮挡和频繁切镜时会出现人物不一致，后续会开放上传自己的视频，目前处于优惠期。
items.summary_en: airapreel.com swaps a person in a rap video for someone from your photo: pick a template such as Hotel Lobby or Burning Bridges, upload a picture, and the AI tries to preserve the original motion, scene and camera work with no prompt writing. The author admits results wobble with multiple people, occlusion and frequent cuts, plans to let users upload their own footage, and is running promotional pricing for now.

items.title: AI Agent 正在改写 CPU 的价值：当 Token 变成行动，算力竞争不再只是拼 GPU
items.summary_zh: Arm 云 AI 解决方案架构总监 Ravi Malhotra 提出，在 Agent 场景下衡量 CPU 性能的方式正在改变：除了支撑推理，CPU 还要把模型生成的 Token 转成真实行动，包括代码编译与测试、工具调用、数据库访问和沙箱隔离。Arm 已发布一套评估方法，把工具调用、任务编排和端到端任务执行纳入 CPU 性能评价，并与富士通、Meta、OpenAI 等企业共同探索。文章指出，若 CPU 侧的编译测试跟不上，昂贵的 GPU 只能空等，正在做 AI 基础设施选型与算力配比的人可据此重新权衡。
items.summary_en: Arm's cloud AI solutions architecture director Ravi Malhotra argues that in agentic workloads, CPU performance should no longer be judged mainly by token generation. The CPU has to turn generated tokens into actions such as compiling and testing code, calling tools, hitting databases and isolating sandboxes, while accelerators handle planning. Arm has published an evaluation method covering tool calls, orchestration and end-to-end task execution, developed with Fujitsu, Meta, OpenAI and others. If CPU-side work lags, expensive GPUs sit idle.

Familiarity with Codex, Cursor, Claude Code and GitHub Copilot is required, but AI output must be human-reviewed. Contact is via Telegram.

items.title: [分享创造] 分享一个小项目：把 ripgrep 做成跨平台的单文件 rg.com，还支持 Python / Node.js / Java 调用
items.summary_zh: 有开发者把 ripgrep 打包成 APE（Actually Portable Executable），产出单文件 rg.com，可在 Windows、Linux、macOS 上运行，覆盖 x86_64 与 ARM64。再借助 APEBind 生成统一的调用接口，Python、Node.js、Java 里都能直接调用 rg，省去按平台和架构分别构建的麻烦。
items.summary_en: A developer packaged ripgrep as an APE (Actually Portable Executable), producing a single rg.com binary that runs on Windows, Linux and macOS across both x86_64 and ARM64. APEBind then generates uniform call interfaces for Python, Node.js and Java, so scripts can invoke rg without per-platform builds. The same trick produced sympy-ape and tika-ape, letting Java or Node.js call SymPy without Python installed, and Python use Apache Tika without a JVM.

items.title: 刘铁岩、诺奖、图灵奖得主等嘉宾共话AI的下一个十年：Transformer一统天下之后，AI的下一张王牌是什么？
items.summary_zh: 在 ICAAS 2026 首场圆桌上，诺贝尔化学奖得主迈克尔·莱维特、图灵奖得主杰克·唐加拉与数学家马骁、中关村学院何纪言探讨了 Transformer 路线收敛之后 AI 的下一步。莱维特主张像谨慎的银行家一样分散下注，唐加拉强调探索主流之外并接受失败，嘉宾还就 AI 寒冬是否会重演展开了争论。
items.summary_en: At the opening roundtable of ICAAS 2026, Nobel chemistry laureate Michael Levitt, 2021 Turing winner Jack Dongarra, mathematician Ma Xiao and He Jiyan of Zhongguancun Academy debated where AI goes after the industry converged on Transformer-scale training. Levitt argued for hedging like a cautious banker rather than betting everything on one route; Dongarra pushed for exploring beyond the mainstream and treating failure as part of research. They clashed over whether overpromising could trigger another AI winter.

items.title: 讯飞发布新一代端到端交互模型：语音大模型调用量暴涨20倍，端侧已实现约70%云端能力
items.summary_zh: 科大讯飞 10 月 22 日发布星火语音基座大模型 SparkAudio 1.0，在语音识别与同传之外加入音频理解、情绪识别、实时说话人分离和环境声理解，并推出端云一体的星火 X2.6 与 4B 端侧模型 Spark-X2.6-4B。官方称语音大模型调用量同比增长超 20 倍，端侧已具备约 70% 云端能力，相关能力进入讯飞输入法 16.0 等产品，针对的是机器人与智能家居里多人同时说话、环境嘈杂的真实场景。
items.summary_en: iFlytek unveiled SparkAudio 1.0 on October 22, a speech foundation model that moves past ASR and translation to cover audio understanding, emotion recognition, real-time speaker separation and ambient sound. It also showed the cloud-device Spark X2.6 and a 4B on-device model, Spark-X2.6-4B. iFlytek says speech model calls are up more than 20x year over year and on-device models now handle roughly 70% of cloud capability, with the tech already shipping in iFlytek Input 16.0 for robots, cars and smart-home devices where several people talk over background noise.

items.title: 智源众智 FlagOS 2.2 让前沿模型与多元算力协同演进
items.summary_zh: 智源众智 FlagOS 2.2 的九大算子库合计覆盖 1454 个算子，比上一版增加 890 个，并在 10 款异构 AI 芯片、上千个算子上把跨芯性能整体提升约 27%。实践中 GLM-5.3-Flash 在存量昇腾 910B 上逻辑服务吞吐达优化前的 2.04 倍，按租金折算的算力成本比商业 API 参考计费低 19.4%—27.6%。
items.summary_en: FlagOS 2.2 now bundles nine operator libraries covering 1,454 operators, 890 more than the previous release, and reports roughly 27% overall cross-chip performance gains measured across 10 heterogeneous AI chips and over a thousand operators. In one deployment with GLM-5.3-Flash, existing Ascend 910B hardware served 2.04x its previous logical throughput, with rent-equivalent compute cost running 19.4%–27.6% below comparable commercial API pricing.

items.title: 上下文语言模型：通过自主管理上下文提升性能、降低计算成本
items.summary_zh: Meta、MIT 与华盛顿大学提出上下文语言模型（CLM），把上下文当作可反复改写的文件，让模型自主删除无关信息、保留关键事实、记录进度，不再依赖摘要、压缩或检索。零样本下 BrowseComp-Plus 准确率提升 11.4% 且算力减少 21.5%，经强化学习训练的 Qwen3.5-9B 在同一基准从 28.8% 升至 42.5%。
items.summary_en: Researchers from Meta, MIT and the University of Washington propose Context Language Model, which treats context as a freely rewritable file: the model deletes irrelevant turns, keeps key facts and tracks progress instead of relying on summarization or retrieval. Zero-shot it lifts BrowseComp-Plus accuracy by 11.4% with 21.5% fewer FLOPs, and an RL-trained Qwen3.5-9B climbs from 28.8% to 42.5% on the same benchmark.

items.title: PostgreSQL 19 发不出来？AI“找茬”太快，人类修Bug的速度跟不上了
items.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 19 从 10 月 29 日推迟到 11 月 19 日发布，中间加发一个 RC2；Beta 阶段有 8 到 10 项重要功能被撤回。核心提交者、EDB 副总裁 Peter Eisentraut 解释，问题多不是 vibe coding 造成，而是 LLM 辅助代码审查与模糊测试把原本要五年才暴露的长尾缺陷集中翻了出来，人类修 Bug 的速度跟不上。
items.summary_en: PostgreSQL 19 slipped from October 29 to November 19, with an extra RC2 on November 12, after roughly 8 to 10 significant features were reverted during beta. Core committer and EDB vice president Peter Eisentraut says the cause is not vibe coding but maturing LLM-assisted code review and fuzzing, which surfaced long-tail defects that would otherwise have trickled in over five years. AI raised the effective quality bar faster than humans can fix bugs.

items.title: [Chrome] 测试一下 Chrome 最新支持的 JXL HDR 图片格式
items.summary_zh: Chrome 与 Firefox 近期都加入了对 JXL 图片的支持，网页终于能直接显示采用 PQ transfer 的 HDR 图片。帖中样图由开源工具 LocalViewer 转换导出，该工具能把 JXR 和相机 RAW 转成 JXL、JPEG、AVIF 等多种 HDR 输出，并附了各格式的位深与 base+gain map 对照。
items.summary_en: Chrome and Firefox have both recently shipped JPEG XL support, so web pages can finally display HDR images using the PQ transfer function directly. The sample images in the post were exported with LocalViewer, an open-source converter that turns JXR and camera RAW files into JXL, JPEG and AVIF HDR variants, including 16-bit float JXL with luminance metadata and base-plus-gain-map JPEG.

items.title: 奥特曼最新 45 分钟访谈：一年不写代码、压力大到不想起床，还嫌 ChatGPT 太谄媚
items.summary_zh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在与博主 Matthew Berman 的 45 分钟访谈中称，自己已约一年没写过代码，并预计未来几年 AI 能提出重大疾病的候选治疗方案。他发现程序员并未因 AI 失业，反而更忙、赚得更多，对算力的需求则是「无限多」。访谈也谈到 AI 意识、失控风险，以及他压力大到不想起床的一面。
items.summary_en: In a 45-minute interview with AI blogger Matthew Berman, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said he hasn't looked at a line of code in about a year and expects AI to surface candidate treatments for major diseases within a few years. He argued programmers aren't losing jobs to AI but are busier and earning more, and put his GPU demand at effectively unlimited. The conversation also covered AI consciousness, loss-of-control risk, and the pressure that sometimes keeps him in bed.

items.title: 决策模型也有专用推理引擎了：StartLux 开源 Prism，单卡最高提速 5.3 倍
items.summary_zh: StartLux 开源了为自家决策模型 StartLux-Decision 定制的推理引擎 Prism，在单张 NVIDIA H200 上跑 27B 模型时速度达到 vLLM 方案的 1.2 至 5.3 倍，同一份材料连答三问从 92.9 毫秒降到 17.4 毫秒。它只计算候选选项的概率而不生成整段文本，并保证相同请求输出逐位一致，12,351 次决策测试准确率 92.94%，与 BF16 的 92.97% 基本持平。
items.summary_en: StartLux has open-sourced Prism, an inference engine built specifically for its StartLux-Decision model. On a single NVIDIA H200 running the 27B model, it claims 1.2x to 5.3x the speed of vLLM, cutting a three-question task on one document from 92.9ms to 17.4ms. Because decision models only score a handful of candidate options rather than generate full text, Prism skips whole-vocabulary output and returns bit-identical results regardless of batching; accuracy was 92.94% against 92.97% in BF16.

Useful for engineers who want to understand how targeting actually works and where the privacy line sits.

items.summary_en: Writing on 掘金, author 狂师 splits programming skill in the AI era into two tracks: non-technical people need to "use" — grasp basic concepts, state requirements clearly and do light acceptance checks — while engineers need to "judge", keeping syntax fundamentals but shifting focus to reading AI-generated code and assessing its quality and risk. His claim is simple: let AI write, keep the responsibility human.
